feasibility.interpretation: Type0 power.1 is a signed native thrust setting (dFdPe=1), not watts. Positive thrust is reported explicitly; it alone does not establish human-power or actuator feasibility. Any negative thrust remains a declared braking conditional point, with no clipping or retargeting. No control-travel or human-power limits are supplied by the literal model. All source jet-domain and clipping guards remain active.
